filter_params: pagesize=1000&page={page} — no TypeOfViolence filter; pulls all events; aggregate sum(best) by (canonical_country, year) across type_of_violence in {1,2,3}
transform: sum — aggregate sum(best) across ALL GED events for a country-year regardless of type_of_violence
notes: Full GED paginated pull (requires x-ucdp-access-token header). The `best` field is the best-estimate fatality count per event. Country mapped from GED `country` name field to canonical via the existing UCDP_NAME_OVERRIDES map (same pattern as existing fetch_ucdp.py). This is identical to the existing UC-01/UC-04 fetch pattern but summed across all type_of_violence values (1=state-based, 2=non-state, 3=one-sided). Share the paginated GED download cache across all GED-derived indicators to avoid duplicate fetches. Token required since 2025; request from mertcan.yilmaz@pcr.uu.se. Auth: HTTP header x-ucdp-access-token.

filter_params: pagesize=1000&TypeOfViolence=1 — filter to type_of_violence==1 (state-based); aggregate sum(best) by (canonical_country, year)
transform: sum — sum(best) where type_of_violence==1 per country-year
notes: Directly extends existing UC-01 logic in fetch_ucdp.py (type_of_violence=1). The existing SPECS dict maps UC-01 to tov=1 and already computes this; UCDP_SB_DEATHS_BEST is the enrichment-track canonical code for the same series. Reuse parse_ged_records() with tov=1. Country field is name string, mapped via UCDP_NAME_OVERRIDES. Token required.

filter_params: pagesize=1000&TypeOfViolence=2 — filter to type_of_violence==2 (non-state); aggregate sum(best) by (canonical_country, year)
transform: sum — sum(best) where type_of_violence==2 per country-year
notes: type_of_violence=2 codes non-state (communal/militia) conflict events. GED `country` field gives the territory where the event occurred. Reuse parse_ged_records() with tov=2. Shares the full GED download cache. Token required.

filter_params: pagesize=1000&TypeOfViolence=3 — filter to type_of_violence==3 (one-sided); aggregate sum(best) by (canonical_country, year)
transform: sum — sum(best) where type_of_violence==3 per country-year
notes: Directly extends existing UC-04 logic in fetch_ucdp.py (type_of_violence=3). Reuse parse_ged_records() with tov=3. Country mapped via name string + UCDP_NAME_OVERRIDES. Token required. This aggregates ALL one-sided violence perpetrators (government + non-state actors).

filter_params: pagesize=1000 — no TypeOfViolence filter; aggregate sum(deaths_civilians) by (canonical_country, year) across all event types
transform: sum — sum(deaths_civilians) across all GED events per country-year
notes: GED field `deaths_civilians` is the best-estimate count of civilian fatalities per event (distinct from combatant deaths). Sum across all type_of_violence values to get total civilian deaths from all organized violence. Country mapped via name string. Shares GED download cache. Token required.

filter_params: pagesize=1000 — pull full onesided dataset; filter server-side on actor type: keep rows where side_a is a government actor (government_ prefix in actor name or is_government_actor flag); aggregate sum(deaths_best) by (gwno_where, year) using GW->ISO crosswalk
transform: sum — sum(deaths_best) where perpetrator is government actor, per country-year
notes: The UCDP One-Sided Violence dataset (onesided endpoint) provides actor-year observations with deaths_best and gwno_where (GW code of location). Government-perpetrated episodes are identified by the `side_a` name containing 'Government of' or by checking the UCDP Actor classification (actor type = state). gwno_where is a semicolon-separated list of GW codes when violence spans borders — split and attribute to each. GW -> canonical country crosswalk required. Confidence medium because government-actor filtering requires string heuristics on side_a field; no clean binary flag in the API response. Token required.

derivation: UCDP_OS_DEATHS_GOVT: binary(sum(deaths_best where side_a is govt actor) > 0) per country-year
filter_params: pagesize=1000 — same pull as UCDP_OS_DEATHS_GOVT; binarize: 1 if government-perpetrated deaths_best > 0 in country-year else 0
transform: binary — 1 if government one-sided violence deaths > 0 in country-year, else 0
notes: Derived from the same onesided pull as UCDP_OS_DEATHS_GOVT — share the download cache. Binarize after groupby: if any year-country row has government-perpetrated deaths_best > 0 → 1 else 0. Confidence medium because government-actor detection relies on side_a string matching. Token required.

filter_params: pagesize=1000 — pull full onesided dataset; count distinct actor_id values per (gwno_where, year)
transform: count_distinct — count of distinct actor_id values per country-year
notes: actor_id (or dyad_id) in the onesided dataset uniquely identifies the perpetrating actor. nunique(actor_id) per (gwno_where, year) gives the count of distinct one-sided violence actors active in a country-year. gwno_where may be semicolon-separated multi-country — split and attribute to each. GW->canonical crosswalk required. Token required.

filter_params: pagesize=1000&TypeOfViolence=3 — filter to type_of_violence==3; count events (rows) per (canonical_country, year)
transform: count — count of GED events with type_of_violence==3 per country-year
notes: Each GED record is a distinct georeferenced event. Count (not sum of deaths) gives event frequency — i.e. how often one-sided violence incidents occur, regardless of their lethality. Reuse the tov=3 filtered GED records from the UCDP_OS_DEATHS_BEST fetch. Country mapped via name string. Token required.

filter_params: pagesize=1000&TypeOfViolence=2 — filter to type_of_violence==2; count events (rows) per (canonical_country, year)
transform: count — count of GED events with type_of_violence==2 per country-year
notes: Same pattern as UCDP_GED_OS_EVENTS but for non-state (communal) conflict events. Reuse tov=2 filtered GED records from UCDP_NS_DEATHS_BEST fetch. Country mapped via name string. Token required.

filter_params: pagesize=1000 — no TypeOfViolence filter; for each (canonical_country, year) count distinct non-null adm_1 values across all event types
transform: count_distinct — nunique(adm_1) per country-year across all violence types
notes: GED field `adm_1` is the first-order administrative division (province/state/region) where the event was geolocated. nunique(adm_1) per (canonical_country, year) measures geographic spread of conflict within a country. Confidence medium because adm_1 encoding uses UCDP's own place-name strings (not a clean numeric code) and may have inconsistencies across years or transliteration variants — a normalization step (strip/lowercase/dedup) is required. Shares full GED download cache. Token required.

filter_params: pagesize=1000 — pull full organizedviolencecy dataset; filter to rows where sb_exist==1; extract sb_conflict_count per (country_id, year) using GW->ISO crosswalk
transform: none — sb_conflict_count is already aggregated to country-year in the dataset
notes: The organizedviolencecy endpoint provides pre-aggregated country-year summaries. `sb_conflict_count` (exact API field name to verify on first live call — may also appear as a derived count from dyadic rows) gives the number of distinct state-based conflict dyads active in the country-year. country_id is the Gleditsch-Ward (GW) numeric code; requires GW->ISO3 crosswalk to map to canonical country. The organizedviolencecy filters (Sb_exist, Sb_intrastate_exist, etc.) confirm which rows have active state-based conflict. Token required. NOTE: if sb_conflict_count is not a direct API field, derive it by counting distinct conflict_id rows in the ucdpprioconflict endpoint filtered by Country and Year.

derivation: ucdpprioconflict: binary(max(intensity_level) == 2) per (gwno_loc, year); intensity_level=2 means war (>=1000 battle deaths)
filter_params: pagesize=1000 — pull full ucdpprioconflict dataset; for each (gwno_loc, year) set flag=1 if any row has intensity_level==2 (war), else 0
transform: binary — max(intensity_level==2) per country-year; 1=war threshold reached, 0=minor or no conflict
notes: UCDP/PRIO ACD codes intensity_level: 1=minor armed conflict (25-999 battle deaths in year), 2=war (>=1000 battle deaths in year). gwno_loc is the semicolon-separated list of GW country codes where the conflict is fought — split and attribute binary flag to each. GW->canonical crosswalk required. Token required.

filter_params: CSV download only — no REST API endpoint. Filter to new_conflict==1 rows (or onset==1 depending on field name). Binary per (gwno, year).
transform: binary — 1 if new state-based conflict onset in country-year, else 0
notes: UCDP Onset Dataset (v25.1) is NOT available via the REST API — download-only as CSV. Fields confirmed: gwno_a (GW country code), year, onset binary indicators at various recurrence thresholds (new conflict, restart after 1/2/3/5/10/20 years inactive). Use the simplest onset flag (new conflict or restart after any inactivity). GW->canonical crosswalk required. Fetch is a one-time CSV download — cache locally. Confidence medium because the field name for the primary onset binary may differ across versions (onset, new_conflict, onset_2); verify on first load.

filter_params: CSV/Excel download only — no REST API. ESD covers 1975-2017 only. Binary: any external state support to any warring party in country-year.
transform: binary — 1 if any warring party in country-year received external state support, else 0
notes: UCDP External Support Dataset (ESD v18.1) is download-only (CSV, Excel, Stata) — NOT in the REST API. Critical limitation: coverage ends at 2017, leaving an 8+ year gap. Unit of analysis is dyad-year (ESD DY) or actor-year. To produce a country-year binary, aggregate the dyad-year version: flag=1 if any dyad in a country-year has external support. GW->canonical crosswalk required. Due to the 2017 coverage cutoff, this indicator will have a large gap for recent years and may reduce ML signal quality. Mark fetchable=false for automated pipeline; requires a manual download step.

derivation: ucdpprioconflict + organizedviolencecy: for each (canonical_country, year), find the last year with any active organized violence; value = year - last_active_year; 0 if currently active
filter_params: pagesize=1000 — pull full organizedviolencecy dataset; build country-year panel of activity flags; derive years_since = year - max(year where sb_exist|ns_exist|os_exist==1 AND year <= current_year)
transform: derived — years elapsed since last year with sb_exist==1 OR ns_exist==1 OR os_exist==1; 0 if current year has any active conflict
notes: Derived from organizedviolencecy activity flags. Algorithm: (1) Pull all rows; (2) for each country create sorted year panel; (3) for each year t, find max(year') where year'<=t and (sb_exist|ns_exist|os_exist)==1 in that country; (4) value = t - year', or NaN if no prior conflict on record. For years where country is currently active, value=0. GW->canonical crosswalk via country_id field. Token required.

filter_params: CSV/Excel download only — not in REST API. Binary: 1 if at least one peace agreement signed in country-year, else 0. Derived from date_signed field and location country coding.
transform: binary — 1 if any peace agreement signed in country-year, else 0
notes: UCDP Peace Agreement Dataset (PAD v22.2) is download-only (Excel) — NOT in the REST API. Covers 1975-2022. Fields include: id, conflict_id, date_signed, parties, location (country/territory). To produce country-year binary: extract year from date_signed, map location to canonical country, flag=1 if any row matches. The location field may list multiple countries for regional agreements — parse and attribute to each. Confidence medium because: (1) location field is free text requiring NLP/lookup; (2) coverage ends 2022. Requires manual download step.

filter_params: CSV/Excel download only — not in REST API. The Conflict Issues Dataset (CID v23.2) provides dyad-year data with dummy variables for each conflict issue type. Binary: 1 if any active dyad in country-year has territorial/autonomy/secession issue coded, else 0.
transform: binary — 1 if any rebel group with territorial/autonomy/secession demands active in country-year, else 0
notes: UCDP Conflict Issues Dataset (CID v23.2) is download-only — NOT in REST API. Coverage: 1989-2017 (as of the 2024 publication). Unit of analysis: dyad-issue-year. The dyad-year aggregated version has dummy variables for each issue type. Relevant issue categories for secessionism: territorial autonomy, territorial independence, irredentism, secession. Flag = max(territorial_issue==1) per (gwno_a, year). GW->canonical crosswalk required. Critical coverage gap: ends 2017 — 8+ year gap for recent observations. Mark fetchable=false for automated pipeline; requires manual download.

filter_params: CSV/Excel download only — not in REST API. DECO is an event-level dataset. Aggregate: count of DECO events per (country, year) OR sum(deaths_best) per (country, year).
transform: count — count of georeferenced lethal electoral violence events per country-year
notes: DECO (Deadly Electoral Conflict Dataset v1.0, Fjelde & Höglund 2022) is download-only — NOT in REST API. Critical limitation: coverage is 1989-2017 only, making it an 8+ year stale signal. DECO is coded as a derivative of GED — events are a subset of GED records with a lethal electoral link. Unit is event-level (georeferenced); aggregate to country-year as event count. Country field is GED-inherited name string. Confidence low due to: (1) 2017 coverage cutoff; (2) no API access; (3) dataset has not been updated since v1.0 (2021). Consider deriving a proxy from GED directly (events near election dates) as an alternative.

filter_params: Excel download only — not in REST API. VPP is a dyad-year dataset. Aggregate sum(deaths_best) per (gwno_a, year).
transform: sum — sum(deaths_best) from violent political protest events per country-year
notes: UCDP Violent Political Protest (VPP) Dataset covers violent political protests with >=25 fatalities per dyad-year, 1989-2025 (updated annually via VPP GED extract). VPP is NOT in the REST API but the underlying GED events can be identified: VPP events are GED records coded as 'violent protest' sub-type — however the exact GED tag for VPP events is not a simple type_of_violence filter. Best approach: download VPP Excel directly (one-time; annual update) and sum deaths_best by (gwno_a, year). GW->canonical crosswalk required. Confidence medium because: (1) >=25 deaths threshold means sub-threshold protests are excluded; (2) download-only but dataset is updated annually.
